form:FormGroup.label: Data Source
form:FormGroup.helpText: Data source the view queries, such as an index or a searchable store. Only data sources you have Use permission on are listed.

form:FormGroup.label: Pipeline
form:FormGroup.helpText: Pipeline used to extract field values from the original events when the view is queried.

form:FormGroup.label: Meta Filter
form:FormGroup.helpText: Expression that limits which streams are processed when the view is used by an analytic rule, based on stream (meta) fields such as Feed or Type.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Limits which streams analytic rules process.
